answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 5828 Country: India Title: After urine some drop comes out. Question: After urine some drop comes out. Answer ID: 5828 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 377/377=M/1429) Wait till the dripping of urine stops and you are satisfied. In Islamic term it is called ? istebra ?, it is wajib for men to have it; it can be achieved by walking, clearing the throat or lying: قال الشرنبلالی: یلزم الرجل الاستبراء حتی یزول اثر البول و یطمئن قلبہ Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
